messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning to onboard lammy-7b-quant v1 to staging tonight around 21:30 UTC. Who's available to kick off the deploy, run smoke, and confirm rollback readiness?
ben: I can do the deploy at 21:30. @deploy-bot can you queue a 10% canary for staging once I flip the switch?
liam: I'll own smoke tests & quick evals. Will run the core prompt set + embed diffs.
sophia: Quick question — this is the GPTQ 4-bit build, right? If so we should use the smaller instance class for perf tests and note quant config in the catalog.
maya: Yep, 4-bit GPTQ v1. Catalog draft I want to apply after we validate smoke:```
{
  "model": "lammy-7b-quant",
  "version": "v1",
  "pin": "lammy-7b@v1-quant-2026-03-17",
  "quant": "4bit",
  "notes": "staging-only: perf + quality checks"
}
```
ben: I'll deploy then push the catalog pin as a staging-draft. Will also create a rollback tag `lammy-7b@canary-fallback` and an automated revert PR linked to the deploy job.
deploy-bot: Canary job queued: lammy-7b-quant v1 -> 10% traffic on staging (job id: 8421). Status: queued.
liam: Smoke run done (8m): median latency 92ms, p50 token time looks stable, embedding diff vs baseline 0.004 (within threshold). No decoding errors on the main prompt set.
sophia: One outlier on a factual prompt — hallucination span increased. Filing eval ticket #EVAL-423 with examples and failing prompts.
maya: Ok hold on full promotion until #EVAL-423 triaged. Ben — keep the catalog pin in draft and do NOT promote to dedicated or prod.
ben: Ack. Leaving pin as staging-draft, rollback tag ready, revert PR will auto-trigger if we flip the revert flag.
nina: Taking notes for the Friday demo — capturing perf + quality caveats. Thanks team :thumbsup:
maya: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after EVAL triage, or ping here if anyone needs to roll back during the window.
